purpose: Review a finite enterprise merger, acquisition, major-asset-restructuring, divestiture, earnout and integration domain before opening source rows, filing text, deal values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes capacity, product approval, patent and other positive operating milestones. An operating milestone does not identify a deal, counterparty, acquired or disposed asset, control transfer, consideration, condition precedent or closing state; its major-contract branch is already terminal and cannot be relabeled as a corporate transaction.
repository_evidence.scale_adoption_boundary: Campaign168 freezes operating scale and adoption KPIs. Revenue, users, capacity or store growth does not distinguish acquired, divested or organic scale and cannot establish a deal lifecycle or purchase accounting state.
repository_evidence.commercial_terms_boundary: Campaign169 freezes product pricing, regulated tariff, average selling price and commercial term disclosures. Customer or supplier contract terms do not establish a merger, equity or asset control transfer, corporate consideration, earnout or closing condition.
repository_evidence.governance_boundary: Campaign171 freezes board structure and oversight. Board or shareholder approval is one possible deal event, but governance composition does not establish the transaction identity, economics, execution, control transfer or subsequent integration.
repository_evidence.debt_financing_boundary: Campaign161 freezes debt maturity evidence. Borrowing or refinancing may fund an acquisition, but debt tenor, repayment or resilience does not identify the acquired target, consideration, valuation, purchase-price allocation, control or outcome.
repository_evidence.accounting_and_market_boundary: Goodwill, intangible assets, impairment charges, revenue, asset growth and security-price paths are accounting or market outcomes unless tied to a point-in-time transaction identity, purchase-price allocation, measurement-period adjustment and public-event history; they cannot be relabeled as deal quality.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current restructuring or business-combination note cannot be projected backward without announcement, approval, amendment, closing, termination, ownership, consolidation, earnout, compensation, purchase accounting, integration, divestiture, impairment, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, regulator decision or licensed structured source with immutable document bytes and stable deal, filing and observation identifiers

first-public timestamp, trading-session availability and complete announced, signed, board-approved, shareholder-approved, regulator-approved, amended, closed, terminated, withdrawn, corrected and superseded deal-stage timeline
issuer, listed security, acquirer, target, seller, buyer, parent, subsidiary, asset, counterparty, ultimate controller and related-party identity with historical mapping

transaction taxonomy separating merger, equity acquisition, asset acquisition, major-asset restructuring, disposal, spin-off, split-off, asset swap, tender offer, privatization, joint venture and internal reorganization
ownership, voting rights, beneficial interest, board appointment, consolidation scope and control state before and after every transaction stage
consideration form, currency, cash, equity, debt, assumed liability, valuation method, financing source, payment schedule, escrow, holdback and exchange-ratio semantics
related-party status, conflict disclosure, fairness opinion, independent-board, shareholder, antitrust, exchange, sector and other regulatory approval semantics
purchase-price allocation, fair-value adjustment, goodwill, identifiable intangible, deferred tax, noncontrolling interest, bargain purchase and measurement-period revision identity
performance commitment, earnout, contingent consideration, target metric, measurement period, settlement, compensation, waiver, renegotiation and dispute semantics
closing condition, break fee, termination right, amendment, failure, withdrawal, litigation, correction and final outcome identity
integration milestone, synergy claim and realization, restructuring, divestiture, disposal, shutdown, goodwill or intangible impairment and exit outcome with first-public and effective timing

missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, pending, failed, withdrawn, true zero consideration, zero earnout, no goodwill and no impairment semantics plus a complete bounded 2019-2023 manifest, delisting coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, unit, control, accounting-rollforward and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: acquisition_divestiture_deal_lifecycle_and_control_transfer_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer transaction state linking announcement, agreement, approval, amendment, closing or termination to a historically identified acquirer, target, asset and ownership or control transfer.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted point-in-time history freezes immutable documents, deal and party identity, transaction type, stage transitions, conditions, ownership and control before and after, corrections and trading-session availability across the full 2019-2023 issuer universe.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: consideration_financing_valuation_and_purchase_price_allocation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer deal-economics state covering consideration form, financing, valuation, payment terms and purchase-price allocation into identifiable assets, liabilities, goodwill and noncontrolling interests.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete history connecting each transaction and amendment to currency and units, cash/share/debt terms, exchange ratios, assumed liabilities, funding, payment timing, valuation methods, PPA and measurement-period revisions without hindsight.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: performance_commitment_earnout_contingent_consideration_and_compensation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer performance-commitment or earnout state linking promised targets and measurement periods to contingent consideration, compensation, waiver, renegotiation, settlement or dispute.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves target definition, accounting scope, responsible party, measurement period, achievement determination, contingent liability or asset, payment or share transfer, waiver, dispute, correction and first-public history for every covered deal.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: post_merger_integration_synergy_divestiture_and_goodwill_impairment_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer post-transaction state linking integration and synergy milestones, restructuring or disposal actions, acquired-business outcomes and deal-specific goodwill or intangible impairment.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time lineage connects announced integration plans and synergy baselines to deal-specific operating scope, later divestitures, shutdowns, impairment units, allocation history, revisions, timing and public availability without survivorship or outcome leakage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: major_contract_announcement_count_revenue_asset_growth_goodwill_balance_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing contract, accounting, scale, financing, governance or security-price state relabeled as a merger, restructuring or deal-quality state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Announcement counts, major contracts, revenue or asset growth, standalone goodwill, debt, board approval or security-price reactions do not identify both transaction parties, the transferred asset or control, lifecycle, consideration, purchase accounting, earnout or integration outcome; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: deal_direction_stage_scale_valuation_denominator_event_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of deal stage, consideration, premium, valuation, ownership, earnout, integration, impairment or event timing against assets, revenue, market value, peers or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing acquisition versus disposal, announcement versus closing, larger versus smaller, premium versus discount, denominator, related-party subset, successful-only sample, sector peer, event window or direction before base source admission would multiply hypotheses and invite outcome leakage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_deal_quality_earnout_integration_and_impairment_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer transaction score across lifecycle execution, consideration and valuation, performance commitments, integration, disposal and impairment outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before any component has a complete point-in-time source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct enterprise transaction states remain deferred at source admission; contract, accounting, scale, financing, governance or security-price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions in the Campaign177 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
